_about.purpose: Adjudicated basis (gross / net / unknown) of the prior-year development figure for records whose extraction note evidences a basis other than the gross figure the extraction prompt requests. Read by run_analysis.py after the structured rules (a pipeline triangle override carries the triangle's basis; a net claims triangle carries net); the register decides the remaining cases from the extraction's own data_quality_notes, quoted here as evidence. Records absent from the register with no structured evidence are gross-stated: the prompt defines the field as the gross figure and the dual-model cross-validation stands behind it.
_about.rule: only basis == gross is eligible for the gross calibration; net and unknown are excluded and counted
